inline_text:
Filing as an issue since landscape PRs are paused...

1. Colorado SB 24-205 is listed under "Enacted Legislation & Acts". It never took effect: SB 25B-004 delayed its operative date to 2026-06-30, and SB 26-189 (signed 2026-05-14, "repeals and reenacts", effective 2027-01-01) replaced it. The entry should be SB 26-189, the Automated Decision-Making Technology Act, `homepage_url` https://leg.colorado.gov/bills/sb26-189.
2. Singapore's Model AI Governance Framework for Agentic AI sits under the same heading. It is voluntary guidance; the Governance WG's own landscape analysis says so. It belongs under "Standards & Risk Frameworks".
3. The EU AI Act and Singapore descriptions both open "World's first", which `docs/data-schemas.md` rules out ("first" is on its list). The EU AI Act's `homepage_url` is a third-party explainer; the charter asks for the authoritative upstream, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2024/1689/oj.
